description: Reads a run's event stream, optionally only events newer than a given event_id, for UI polling.
signature: def read_run_events(conn: sqlite3.Connection, run_id: str, *, since_event_id: int = 0) -> list[RunEvent]
docstring:
Read events for a run.

Args:
    conn: An open connection.
    run_id: The run to read events for.
    since_event_id: Only events with event_id strictly greater than this are returned; 0 returns the full history.

Returns:
    A list of RunEvent ordered by event_id ascending (oldest first, matching how a log/progress feed is naturally consumed).
postconditions: Returned events are strictly ordered by event_id ascending
Every returned event has event_id > since_event_id
Returns an empty list, not an error, for a run_id with no events yet or an unknown run_id

edge_cases.input: since_event_id greater than the highest existing event_id
run_id unknown or has zero events
edge_cases.expected_behavior: returns an empty list, not an exception

edge_cases.input: Called repeatedly with since_event_id set to the last-seen event_id (typical UI polling pattern)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: each call returns only strictly new events, with no duplicates and no gaps, even under concurrent appends

unit_tests.name: test_read_full_history
unit_tests.description: since_event_id=0 returns all events for the run in insertion order.
unit_tests.expected: list of all RunEvent for the run, ascending by event_id

unit_tests.name: test_read_since_last_seen
unit_tests.description: Polling with since_event_id equal to the last event's id returns only events appended afterward.
unit_tests.expected: list containing only the newly appended events
